blocks.html: Admit it, your adorable pets make the holidays, a hundred times more special – you prepare “gifts” for them and even scout for matching Christmas outfits! Christmas isn’t complete without spending it with the people – and animals—you truly love and care for.

This year, Robinsons Malls, in partnership with Pet Lovers Centre, gives you the ultimate five fun ways of celebrating Christmas with your pets with a weeklong petclusive event dubbed as Santa’s Pet Village, happening until December 26 at Robinsons Magnolia Atrium.

Get your cookie monsters ready and get the chance to win a Php2,000-worth of pawty package when you register your pets at the Pawsta Eating Contest – either Small-Medium Category or Large Breed category. The first pet to finish the bowl of spaghetti wins the prize.
Watch ten lovely cats and dogs strut the runway with their cutest Christmas costumes. Three best dressed and three special awardees shall take home special pet goodies from Pet Lovers Centre.

Robinsons Malls advocates responsible pet ownership and with this, they make sure that all pet parent are equipped with the right knowledge of raising healthy and happy pets. Participate and attend the event’s various Pet Talks about pet nutrition, grooming, training, and more.

Nothing beats the gift of good health. At Santa’s Pet Village, there will be free vet consultation and anti-rabies vaccination to help make sure that your furbabies are always in tip-top shape. Pre-register your pets at Pet Lovers Centre Magnolia branch now.
On December 24 and 25, five lucky pets visiting Santa’s Pet Village at Robinsons Magnolia will receive P1,000 worth of Pet Lovers Centre products!. Yes, it’s that easy!
To know more about Santa’s Pet Village and other exciting activities, follow Robinsons Magnolia, Pet Lovers Centre Philippines and Robinsons Malls Happy Pets Club in Facebook.
